body:
# 🏠 ShadowHomes

### Simple. Fast. Reliable.

ShadowHomes is a lightweight and modern homes plugin designed for Paper servers. Give your players an intuitive way to create, manage, and teleport to their homes through a clean GUI while keeping performance as the top priority.

Built for modern Minecraft servers with simplicity, speed, and stability in mind.

---

# ✨ Features

## 🏡 Set Home System

Allow players to create personal homes anywhere in the world.

* Create homes instantly
* Custom home names
* Fast teleportation
* Multiple homes support
* Clean and intuitive GUI
* Lightweight and optimized

---

## 🌍 Home Management GUI

Manage all homes through a modern inventory interface.

### GUI Features

* View all saved homes
* Teleport with a single click
* Rename homes
* Delete unwanted homes
* Visual home management
* Beginner-friendly interface

---

## ⭐ Spawn Management

Easily configure your server's global spawn location.

### Spawn Features

* Set server spawn location
* Teleport players to spawn
* Consistent spawn experience
* Administrator-friendly setup

---

# 🔐 Permissions

## Home Limits

| Permission            | Description     |
| --------------------- | --------------- |
| `shadowhomes.home.1`  | Allows 1 home   |
| `shadowhomes.home.2`  | Allows 2 homes  |
| `shadowhomes.home.3`  | Allows 3 homes  |
| `shadowhomes.home.5`  | Allows 5 homes  |
| `shadowhomes.home.10` | Allows 10 homes |
| `shadowhomes.home.*`  | Unlimited homes |

### Example

Giving a player:

```text
shadowhomes.home.1
```

will allow them to create and use **1 home**.

---

# 📜 Commands

## Player Commands

```text
/sethome
```

Create a new home.

```text
/homes
```

Open the homes GUI.

```text
/home <name>
```

Teleport to a home.

```text
/delhome <name>
```

Delete a home.

```text
/spawn
```

Teleport to spawn.

---

## Admin Commands

```text
/setspawn
```

Set the server spawn location.

---

# ⚡ Performance

ShadowHomes was built with performance in mind.

* Lightweight architecture
* Minimal memory usage
* Fast data handling
* Clean codebase
* Designed for modern Paper servers
* Suitable for both small and large communities

---

# 🎯 Why ShadowHomes?

Many homes plugins become bloated with unnecessary features. ShadowHomes focuses on what matters most:

✅ Reliable Home System
✅ Modern GUI Experience
✅ Spawn Management
✅ Permission-Based Home Limits
✅ Lightweight Performance
✅ Easy Configuration

---

# ❤️ Support

If you encounter any issues or have feature suggestions, feel free to open an issue or contact the developer.

**ShadowHomes** • Your Homes. Anywhere.
